reply_text:
I told Ilse in our DM that her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. I got that from her own Oct 14 message in that DM, which she can see herself.

gbrain refused to look up the saved note, so it read nothing. This brain serves several people, and the connection isn't tied to any one of them. That means private notes like this one can't be looked up right now. Someone with admin access on the brain host has to tie the connection to a person. If you want that, the command is:

    gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<MEMBER>'

A shared bot like this one would instead use `--may-act-for <members>` and name the person on each call.
